newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 grows provisional 7.1 pct in year to Dec.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 grows provisional 7.1 pct in year to Dec.

text.p: The Bank of England released the following provisional data on M0 money supply -
* November's comparative figures are preliminary figures released on December 2
NOTE - consensus forecast 7.1 pct yr/yr s/adj growth.

The Bank of England said the seasonal adjustments for narrow money are derived from data to end-November because of the difficulty of assessing any change in seasonality in the December data before the large rise in the note circulation, associated with Christmans, has unwound.
As a result, the seasonal adjustments may not remove the seasonal effects in this period as precisely as at other times of the year.
